data.title: Our panels – Visolaje, a Slavic barrow cemetery
data.excerpt: On 28 May 2017 our civic association Hradiská, together with the municipality of Visolaje, installed information panels at a barrow cemetery from the time of Great Moravia. Slavs from the Slavibor group camped beside the barrows, and the discoverer of the site, Štefan Meliš, accepted our invitation as well.

children.text: On 28 May 2017 our civic association Hradiská, in cooperation with the municipality of Visolaje, installed information panels with which we want to draw attention to an important place of our Slavic ancestors –
a barrow cemetery from the time of Great Moravia
We put the panel up at the barrow cemetery on the Saturday. That evening Slavs from

came to camp near the cemetery; they had decided to support our event by taking part and to show the inhabitants of the village and the surrounding area the life of our ancestors in the 9th century, when we were ruled by figures such as Rastislav and Svatopluk.

Our invitation was also accepted by the discoverer of the barrow cemetery and a living legend – Štefan Meliš, and by Mr Ladislav Janech, who runs a wonderful museum of history in Považská Teplá. He brought part of his archaeological collection to the event.

children.text: The mayor of the village, Mr Vincenc Hrenák, arranged a pleasant get-together for the participants and the visitors at a hunting lodge not far from the barrow cemetery. Live music provided the entertainment and the smell of tasty goulash was everywhere. After a short opening speech we moved together with the visitors to the barrow cemetery, where we first unveiled the panel, after which the lads from Slavibor gave demonstrations of the fighting of the old Slavs and christened the panel with genuine Old Slavic mead. Then we talked about interesting details of the barrows and had a look round the camp of the Slavs, who also told everyone about the life of our ancestors in detail.

The event was a real success. I would like to thank the mayor, Mr Hrenák, for his helpfulness in producing the panels, for funding them from the municipal budget and for the excellent organisation of the whole event. Thanks go to Slavibor, who came in their free time to support us and who did much to make the event very attractive. Finally, thanks also go to Pumukli for the original drawing of the barrow cemetery and to our lads from the association for their active help in making the panels and in installing them on the Saturday.
